meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会先扫描项目里没人引用的代码(函数、导入、参数、整个文件),用 LSP 逐个核实,再按文件分批派并行子代理删除并逐批提交,最后给出移除清单以及 typecheck、测试、构建的验证结果。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理项目里未使用的代码时接管;也可指定文件、目录或符号名来缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里的死代码
say.note: 先扫描并用 LSP 核实,再分批移除

say.text: 只扫描 src/utils 目录里的死代码
say.note: 扫描范围缩小到该目录

say.text: 移除未使用的函数 unusedFunc,别动其他文件

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for code nothing references (functions, imports, params, whole files), confirms each with LSP, batches by file, delegates removals to parallel agents with per-batch commits, then reports what was removed plus typecheck, test and build results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup" etc., or ask to clean up unused code. You can narrow the scan to a file, directory or symbol name.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project
say_en.note: Scans and LSP-verifies, then removes in batches

say_en.text: Only scan src/utils for dead code
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Remove the unused function unusedFunc, leave other files alone
say_en.note: Limits scope to a single symbol
